subject: Activation roadmap & POC tactical issues - DataStream proof-of-concept
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@datastream.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap & proposed activation roadmap

Hi Emma — great to meet you and the DataStream team on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before we lock the kickoff date.

Summary of what we committed to on the demo:
- Short pilot (3 weeks) to validate 3 core success criteria (see below).
- Dedicated test environment with data isolation for your DevOps team.
- Minimal integration (HTTP API + sample ingestion) to measure latency and cost under typical load.

Proposed success criteria (we can refine):
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 512-token generation in your staging topology.
2) Accuracy: top-1 relevance >= 85% on the 200-sample eval set you shared.
3) Cost: per-1k-token cost not to exceed the target we discussed ($1.20 equivalent).

Immediate next steps / owners:
- DataStream: confirm evaluation samples and internal test account (owner: Emma).
- Redwood: provide POC plan + SOC2 summary + mutual action plan (owners: me + Irene).
- Solutions: SRE checklist and escalation contacts (owner: Stephanie).

Proposed dates:
- Kickoff: Dec 6 (one-week prep window)
- Run window: Dec 7–Dec 28 (3 full weeks)

Attachments I will share after this thread: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan-datastream.xlsx. Please confirm the kickoff date and the primary technical contact for the POC.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

From: Emma Ruiz <emma@datastream.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@datastream.com, procurement@datastream.com
Date: 2026-11-29T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & proposed activation roadmap

Thanks, Vivek — appreciate the clear write-up. A few clarifications from our side before we confirm kickoff: 

1) Internal stakeholders: I'll be the technical owner, but our Head of Data (Liam Park) and Procurement (procurement@datastream.com) need the MAA and SOC2 summary to clear legal.
2) Timeline: Dec 6 kickoff is OK for us but procurement may take 5–7 business days to sign the MAA once it is in DocuSign.
3) Top risk: we need assurances around data handling in the staging environment — can you confirm encryption at rest and that logs will not be retained beyond the POC window?

Can your team send the SOC2 summary and the MAA draft today? Also please include a short risk matrix so our SREs can do a pre-check.

—Emma
Emma Ruiz | Senior Product Manager, DataStream Inc
emma@datastream.com | +1 (617) 555-8770

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@datastream.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & proposed activation roadmap

Hi Emma — thanks for the quick reply. Attaching the three artifacts in this thread (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan-datastream.xlsx) — see attachments list. Short answers to your questions and a refined plan below.

Data handling and security:
- Encryption: All POC data in staging will be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
- Retention: We will set log retention to 7 days for the trial unless you request immediate purge; we can schedule a purge at trial end.
- Access: Customer-managed API keys and optional IP allow-listing for your test accounts.

Refined POC timeline and owners: 
- Dec 6: Kickoff + SRE pre-check (owner: Emma/Liam + Stephanie)
- Dec 7–Dec 21: Run window (owner: DataStream test team + Redwood on-call)
- Dec 22–Dec 23: Eval and handover; Redwood to deliver run metrics and cost estimates (owner: Vivek + Marissa)

Success criteria (finalized):
- Latency: 95p < 250ms (512 tokens) — pass/fail
- Relevance: >=85% top-1 on the agreed eval set — pass/fail
- Stability: no more than 3 service interruptions >1m that impact test agents — pass/fail

Escalation path (POC):
- Level 1: Stephanie Nguyen (solutions engineer) — initial triage and runbook fixes. stephanie@redwood.com
- Level 2: Marissa Cole (platform lead) — config/infra escalation. marissa@redwood.com
- Level 3: Irene Choi (Head of Customer Reliability) — SLA/issues requiring exec attention. irene@redwood.com

Please confirm: (a) kickoff on Dec 6, (b) acceptance of the 7-day log retention (we'll purge on Dec 24 by default), and (c) procurement timeline so we can plan the DocuSign send date.

Thanks — Vivek

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@datastream.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap & POC tactical issues — risk register + mitigations

Hi all — adding a concise risk register and the mitigation/escalation ladder so DataStream can share internally. Pulling this from the POC plan, but I wanted to call out priority items we should monitor during the run.

Risk register (top 4):
1) Data exposure risk — severity: high. Mitigation: encrypt in transit+rest, mask PII in test set, provide optional air-gapped collection if needed. Escalation: Stephanie -> Marissa -> Irene.
2) Performance regressions at scale — severity: medium-high. Mitigation: continuous batching limits, can switch to lower-latency model variant for emergency. Escalation: Stephanie -> Marissa.
3) Integration incompatibility (auth / proxy) — severity: medium. Mitigation: pre-kickoff SRE checklist and test account; one-week prep for proxy configs. Escalation: Stephanie.
4) Procurement delay — severity: medium. Mitigation: provide interim access with NDA-local approval and sandbox keys; prioritize scope-limited demo if contract is delayed. Escalation: Vivek -> Sales leadership.

Operational notes:
- If you hit a blocking bug during the run, flag it in the shared issue tracker (link in HubSpot ticket) and add the tag "poc-blocker". Stephanie will triage within 2 business hours for severity >=2.
- For anything that prevents the POC from completing to the success criteria (e.g., sustained latency > target despite mitigations), we will invoke the fallback model variant and notify DataStream within 30 minutes.

Irene Choi | Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
